title: ESTA and Visa Waiver Program - basics
facts: Eligible nationals of Visa Waiver Program countries generally need an approved ESTA before traveling to the United States by air or sea under the VWP.
ESTA authorization is not a visa and does not guarantee admission; CBP makes the admission decision at the border.
VWP admission is generally for tourism or business visits of 90 days or less, subject to program eligibility and restrictions.
Travelers with certain travel histories, dual nationalities or other circumstances can be ineligible for ESTA and may need a visa.
